messages:
alex: Heads up — planning to run the migration/backfill for feature_flags.flags_meta on Wednesday 02:00 UTC (change window). Expect ~1.2M rows. tagging @maria @kevin for rollback criteria and monitoring.

maria: Thanks. What's the backfill plan? full scan or incremental? Any locking risk?

alex: Incremental backfill using tenant batches, rate-limited. No exclusive locks; we add new column flags_v2 and populate in batches. Quick snippet of the apply we plan to run:

alex: ```sql
ALTER TABLE feature_flags ADD COLUMN flags_v2 jsonb;
-- backfill loop runs tenant_id ranges in small batches
UPDATE feature_flags SET flags_v2 = transform(old_flags) WHERE tenant_id BETWEEN $start AND $end;
``` 

kevin: Sounds good. Two asks: 1) pin the app rollout to old schema on canary until backfill > 50% and error rate stable. 2) deploybot should gate on replica lag < 2s and CPU < 70% on workers.

deploy-bot: scheduled migration job mig_391 queued for 2026-03-25T02:00:00Z. Holdpoint set: manual-unblock required after preflight checks. Health checks: read-replica-lag, worker-cpu, pg-lock-wait > 5s.

oncall-sre: Re: replica lag — we'll run a short quiesce on analytic replicas before the heavy backfill. I can do it during the window. Also add alert: if streaming-lag > 5m abort and notify #incidents.

maria: Rollback plan: if we see >1% 500s from feature flag endpoints or backfill errors > 0.2% for 10m, stop the backfill and revert writes to flags_v2 (we have a safe no-op if not complete). We'll publish a rollback note to the release ticket and tag the canary.

kevin: Add a metric check: tokenized-cache-miss spike > 30% -> stop. Also recommend running one canary batch on staging with real shard to validate transform(old_flags) doesn't drop keys.

alex: Agreed. I'll run the staging canary tonight. For the prod run: steps
1) preflight health check by deploy-bot
2) quiesce analytics replicas
3) run 10% canary tenant batches
4) wait 10m SLO observation
5) continue with staged ramp + autoscale worker pool
6) postbackfill index and promote flags_v2 in app rollout

deploy-bot: Preflight checks passed (schema diff ok, migration script checksum match). Ready for manual-unblock. Use `/deploybot unblock mig_391 --by alex` to proceed.

maria: /lgtm from product side. I will monitor error budgets and run quick smoke after canary.

oncall-sre: I'll keep watch on replica lag and DB lock wait histograms. If anything looks off, ping me directly and I'll pause the backfill.

kevin: One more: add release note blurb about migration duration and rollback steps for on-call to paste into incident templates.

alex: Copying release note: "feature_flags: added flags_v2 column and incremental backfill. Backfill runs in tenant batches with rate limiting. Rollback: stop backfill, app remains on flags_v1, revert incomplete flags_v2 writes. Contact @maria, @kevin, oncall-sre for incident." :thumbsup:

maria: ok — let's aim to unblock at 01:55 UTC to give 5m runway. I'll be on call.

kevin: I'll standby to pin the canary and cut the rollout if we see any regressions.

deploy-bot: Action log: mig_391 unblocked by alex at 1761234750. First 10% canary batches started. Will post updates every batch.

alex: First canary batch succeeded. No errors. continuing to next ramp.

oncall-sre: Replica lag peaked at 1.6s, CPU steady. No lock wait spikes. Good to proceed.

maria: 10m observation looks clean. Proceeding with staged ramp to 50%.

kevin: 50% ramp completed. Watchting for cache miss spikes.

alex: Backfill finished for all tenants. Will schedule postbackfill index after low traffic hours. Thanks everyone :party-parrot:.
